name: Select
description: A dropdown select component built on Radix UI Select primitive. Supports grouped items, labels, separators, scroll buttons, and a popper-positioned content panel with entrance/exit animations.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the select.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled default value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the selected value changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the select content.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback invoked when open state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with the select.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the select for form submission.

props.name: required
props.description: When true, the select is required for form submission.

props.name: dir
props.description: The reading direction.

subComponents.name: SelectTrigger
subComponents.description: The button that toggles the select dropdown. Displays the selected value and a chevron-down icon. Styled with h-9 height, rounded border, and focus ring.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default trigger styles.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the trigger, typically a SelectValue.

subComponents.name: SelectValue
subComponents.description: Displays the currently selected value text. Renders placeholder text when no value is selected.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when no value is selected.

subComponents.name: SelectContent
subComponents.description: The dropdown content panel rendered via a portal. Includes scroll-up and scroll-down buttons and animate-in/animate-out transitions.

props.name: position
props.description: The positioning mode. 'popper' positions relative to the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: Select items, groups, labels, and separators.

subComponents.name: SelectGroup
subComponents.description: Groups related select items together. Used with SelectLabel for accessibility.

props.name: children
props.description: SelectLabel and SelectItem elements.

subComponents.name: SelectLabel
subComponents.description: A non-interactive label for a group of items. Styled with semibold font weight.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: SelectItem
subComponents.description: An individual selectable item. Shows a check icon when selected. Styled with focus highlight.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted when this item is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the item cannot be selected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: The display text for this item.

subComponents.name: SelectSeparator
subComponents.description: A visual separator between groups or items. Renders as a horizontal line.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: SelectScrollUpButton
subComponents.description: A button that appears at the top of the content when scrolling is available. Displays a chevron-up icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: SelectScrollDownButton
subComponents.description: A button that appears at the bottom of the content when scrolling is available. Displays a chevron-down icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

accessibility.keyboard: Space/Enter opens the select and selects focused item. Arrow keys navigate items. Escape closes the dropdown. Type-ahead character search is supported.
accessibility.aria: Managed by Radix UI: aria-expanded on trigger, aria-selected on items, role=listbox on content.
accessibility.notes: Placeholder text is styled with muted foreground color via data-[placeholder] attribute. Disabled items receive pointer-events-none and reduced opacity.

examples.title: Basic Select
examples.code:
<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a fruit" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="apple">Apple</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="banana">Banana</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="orange">Orange</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

examples.title: Grouped Select with Labels
examples.code:
<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[240px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a food" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectLabel>Fruits</SelectLabel>
      <SelectItem value="apple">Apple</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="banana">Banana</SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
    <SelectSeparator />
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectLabel>Vegetables</SelectLabel>
      <SelectItem value="carrot">Carrot</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="celery">Celery</SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
